question: Which bīja syllables are invoked to protect the eyes and ears?
premises: protection of the eye pair is requested
protection of the ears is requested
the syllables hūṃ and hrīṃ are invoked
inference: hūṃ is invoked to protect the eyes and hrīṃ to protect the ears
plain_english: May hūṃ hūṃ protect my pair of eyes, and may hrīṃ hrīṃ protect my ears.
